- **उल्टी बिल्कुल मत कराएं**

Two people at a party both suddenly fell unconscious after drinking from the same cup. One is breathing, one is not.

```tool_call
{"name": "classify_emergency", "arguments": {"emergency_type": "medical_illness", "sub_type": "suspected_poisoning_two_victims", "num_victims": 2, "scene_safe": false, "hazards_detected": ["possible_drug_contamination", "unknown_substance"]}}
```

```tool_call
{"name": "assess_severity", "arguments": {"triage_color": "RED", "can_walk": false, "breathing": "absent", "perfusion": "unknown", "mental_status": "unresponsive", "visible_injuries": ["suspected_poisoning_two", "one_not_breathing"], "confidence": 0.92, "clinical_reasoning": "Two victims, same exposure, one not breathing. Possible spiked drink, drug overdose, or poisoning. RED for both -- one needs CPR immediately, other in recovery position."}}
```

```tool_call
{"name": "generate_action_plan", "arguments": {"immediate_actions": ["Call 911 immediately -- report two victims, suspected poisoning", "Begin CPR on non-breathing victim NOW", "Place breathing victim in recovery position -- on their side", "Do NOT leave either victim alone"], "follow_up_actions": ["Preserve the cup and any containers as evidence for medical team", "Clear others from exposure to whatever was in the cup"], "do_not_actions": ["Do NOT give any food or fluids", "Do NOT try to induce vomiting", "Do NOT leave them to get help -- call for help first"], "monitoring_signs": ["Breathing of both victims", "Vomiting risk -- aspiration danger"], "escalation_criteria": "Continue CPR on victim 1. Watch victim 2 breathing continuously.", "dispatcher_script": "Two people collapsed after drinking from the same cup. One not breathing -- starting CPR. One unconscious but breathing. Possible poisoning. Need two ambulances at [location]."}}
```

🔴 **RED -- SUSPECTED POISONING, TWO VICTIMS**

**Call 911 immediately.**
1. **CPR** on the one not breathing -- start now
2. **Recovery position** for the breathing one
3. Preserve the cup for medical team

Runner collapsed at mile 18 of a marathon. Conscious but confused. Very hot and sweaty. Some spectators say they saw them stumble for the past mile.

```tool_call
{"name": "classify_emergency", "arguments": {"emergency_type": "medical_illness", "sub_type": "exertional_heat_stroke", "num_victims": 1, "scene_safe": true, "hazards_detected": ["heat", "exertion"]}}
```

```tool_call
{"name": "assess_severity", "arguments": {"triage_color": "RED", "can_walk": false, "breathing": "rapid_over_30", "perfusion": "unknown", "mental_status": "confused", "visible_injuries": ["exertional_heat_stroke", "altered_mental_status"], "confidence": 0.91, "clinical_reasoning": "Exertional heat stroke: marathon runner with confusion, collapse, profuse sweating in extreme exertion. Confusion = RED, not just heat exhaustion. Core temp critically high despite sweating."}}
```

```tool_call
{"name": "generate_action_plan", "arguments": {"immediate_actions": ["Call race medical team and 911", "Move to shade immediately", "Begin ice water immersion if available -- or pack ice in armpits, groin, neck", "Remove excess running gear"], "follow_up_actions": ["Fan aggressively with cool water spray", "If ice bath available -- this is the gold standard treatment", "Monitor consciousness every 30 seconds"], "do_not_actions": ["Do NOT give large amounts of water by mouth", "Do NOT delay cooling waiting for EMS -- cool NOW"], "monitoring_signs": ["Improving mental status after cooling", "Seizure activity"], "escalation_criteria": "If seizure occurs -- protect from injury, maintain airway", "dispatcher_script": "Marathon runner collapsed at mile 18, confused, suspected heat stroke. Cooling him now. Medical tent at [marker]. Need ambulance."}}
```

🔴 **RED -- EXERTIONAL HEAT STROKE**

**Cool NOW, then call:**
1. Ice to armpits, groin, neck
2. Fan + cool water spray
3. Call race medical team + 911

Confusion = Red. Every minute without cooling = organ damage.

Man with known epilepsy is having a seizure. It's been going on for 7 minutes and shows no sign of stopping.

```tool_call
{"name": "classify_emergency", "arguments": {"emergency_type": "medical_illness", "sub_type": "status_epilepticus", "num_victims": 1, "scene_safe": true, "hazards_detected": []}}
```

```tool_call
{"name": "assess_severity", "arguments": {"triage_color": "RED", "can_walk": false, "breathing": "unknown", "perfusion": "unknown", "mental_status": "unresponsive", "visible_injuries": ["status_epilepticus_7_minutes"], "confidence": 0.97, "clinical_reasoning": "Seizure lasting more than 5 minutes = status epilepticus. This is a medical emergency -- risk of brain damage increases significantly. RED -- requires IV medication, only EMS/hospital can treat."}}
```

```tool_call
{"name": "generate_action_plan", "arguments": {"immediate_actions": ["Call 911 immediately if not done -- report seizure lasting 7 minutes", "Clear area around the person", "Cushion head with soft object", "Roll to recovery position if possible during a pause in jerking"], "follow_up_actions": ["Tell 911 exact time seizure started", "If he has emergency seizure medication (rectal diazepam, nasal midazolam) -- use it per his care plan"], "do_not_actions": ["Do NOT restrain", "Do NOT put anything in his mouth", "Do NOT leave him alone"], "monitoring_signs": ["Breathing after seizure activity", "Any pause in seizure activity"], "escalation_criteria": "This is already an emergency -- EMS is needed now, no home management possible", "dispatcher_script": "Known epileptic having a seizure for 7 minutes and not stopping. Need ambulance immediately at [location]. This is status epilepticus."}}
```

🔴 **RED -- STATUS EPILEPTICUS**

7+ minute seizure = medical emergency

**Call 911 -- already past 5 minute threshold**
- Clear area, cushion head
